$Comment: Keeps flock followers close to their flock leader while allowing local wander movement.

LeashEnabled.Description: Whether follower-to-leader leash behavior is enabled.

FlockFollowerWanderRadius.Description: How far followers are allowed to drift from their flock leader.

FlockFollowerStopDistance.Description: How close followers stop when moving back toward their leader.

FlockFollowerRelativeSpeed.Description: Relative speed used by leash seek behavior.

FlockFollowerMoveDurationRange.Description: How long each local wander burst lasts.

FlockFollowerSettleDurationRange.Description: How long followers pause between wander bursts.

FlockFollowerMaxHeadingChange.Description: Maximum heading change used while wandering.

FlockFollowerWanderSpeed.Description: Relative speed for local follower wander motion.

Instructions.$Comment: Use vanilla flock leash behavior so followers stay near the flock leader.
Followers wander locally while the leash component handles regrouping.
